Name: Friends of Bigta and Sertors
Description: Play as the army of Bigta and Sertors. The pair will reunite the rabbit alliance once more.

Name: Veterans of Amgarn
Description: Play as the army of Amgarn, the Black Cat. With his swift sword, the cats will rule the world once more.

Name: Gang of Kelwy and Ulistaz
Description: Play as the army of Kelwy and Ulistaz. The best rabbits are those that can evolve and innovate. Hopping into the future.

Name: Friends of Kak
Description: Play as the army of Kak, the Monkey. Perhaps humanity will survive with the little ones.
